properties.name: Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary
properties.source: NOAA ONMS NMS_Boundaries_02032022 (simplified ~500 m, islands not cut out) · https://floridakeys.noaa.gov/zones/

note.en: Fishing allowed outside the marked no-take zones under Florida/federal rules. Sanctuary-wide: no touching or anchoring on coral, no discharges. Federal-water zones follow the 2025 Restoration Blueprint; state waters still use the 1997 zones.
note.es: Se permite pescar fuera de las zonas de no pesca, con las reglas de Florida y federales. En todo el santuario: no tocar ni anclar sobre coral, no descargar. En aguas federales rigen las zonas del Restoration Blueprint 2025; en aguas estatales, las de 1997.

properties.name: Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary
properties.source: NOAA ONMS NMS_Boundaries_02032022 (2021 expansion); 15 CFR 922.122 · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-15/part-922/section-922.122

note.en: Only conventional hook-and-line fishing allowed; spearfishing, longlines, traps and nets prohibited; anchoring prohibited (use mooring buoys).
note.es: Solo se permite pesca con caña/línea y anzuelo; prohibidos la pesca submarina, palangres, trampas y redes; prohibido anclar (usa boyas de amarre).

properties.name: Dry Tortugas Research Natural Area
properties.source: NOAA MPA Inventory 2024 (NOAA_MPA_Inventory_2023 service) · https://www.nps.gov/drto/planyourvisit/fishing.htm

note.en: No fishing of any kind (Dry Tortugas National Park Research Natural Area).
note.es: Prohibida toda pesca (Área Natural de Investigación del Parque Nacional Dry Tortugas).

properties.name: Dry Tortugas National Park
properties.source: NOAA MPA Inventory 2024 (NOAA_MPA_Inventory_2023 service) · https://www.nps.gov/drto/planyourvisit/fishing.htm

note.en: Outside the Research Natural Area: hook-and-line only, circle hooks only, no spearfishing or lobstering; Florida saltwater license required.
note.es: Fuera del Área Natural de Investigación: solo caña y anzuelo circular; prohibidas la pesca submarina y la langosta; se requiere licencia de Florida.

properties.name: Biscayne National Park
properties.source: NOAA MPA Inventory 2024 (NOAA_MPA_Inventory_2023 service) · https://myfwc.com/fishing/saltwater/recreational/bnp/

note.en: Florida rules plus park rules: larger minimum sizes for snappers, red grouper and others; 10-fish aggregate reef-fish bag; no lobster in the bay sanctuary and coral reef protection areas; some harbors closed to fishing.
note.es: Reglas de Florida más reglas del parque: tallas mínimas mayores para pargos, mero rojo y otros; límite conjunto de 10 peces de arrecife; sin langosta en el santuario de la bahía ni en las áreas de protección de arrecife; algunas dársenas cerradas a la pesca.

properties.name: Everglades National Park
properties.source: NOAA MPA Inventory 2024 (NOAA_MPA_Inventory_2023 service) · https://www.nps.gov/ever/planyourvisit/fishing.htm

note.en: Fishing allowed with a Florida license; no lobster or conch; max 20 fish per person (10 of one species); some ponds and the Flamingo marina (daytime) closed; posted pole/troll and manatee zones.
note.es: Pesca permitida con licencia de Florida; sin langosta ni caracol; máximo 20 peces por persona (10 de una especie); algunos estanques y la marina de Flamingo (de día) cerrados; zonas señaladas de vara/remo y de manatíes.

properties.name: Madison-Swanson Marine Reserve
properties.source: 50 CFR 622.34(a) (eCFR as of 2026-11-02) · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/section-622.34

note.en: Fishing prohibited year-round (only Atlantic highly migratory species — tunas, billfish, oceanic sharks — are exempt under 50 CFR 635).
note.es: Pesca prohibida todo el año (solo se exceptúan las especies altamente migratorias: atunes, picudos y tiburones oceánicos, 50 CFR 635).

properties.name: The Edges (40-fathom contour)
properties.source: 50 CFR 622.34(a) (eCFR as of 2026-11-02) · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/section-622.34

note.en: All fishing prohibited January 1 – April 30 (HMS exempt); open the rest of the year.
note.es: Prohibida toda pesca del 1 de enero al 30 de abril (excepto especies altamente migratorias); abierta el resto del año.

properties.name: Pulley Ridge South HAPC
properties.source: 50 CFR 622.74(c)-(d) · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/section-622.74

note.en: Hook-and-line fishing allowed; fishing vessels may not anchor; bottom longline, trawl, buoy gear, pots and traps prohibited.
note.es: Pesca con anzuelo permitida; las embarcaciones de pesca no pueden anclar; prohibidos palangre de fondo, arrastre, palangre de boya, nasas y trampas.

properties.name: North Florida MPA
properties.source: 50 CFR 622.183(a) · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/section-622.183

note.en: No fishing for or keeping snapper-grouper species (bottom fishing); trolling for pelagics (dolphin, wahoo, kings, billfish) is allowed.
note.es: Prohibido pescar o retener pargos, meros y demás especies de fondo del complejo snapper-grouper; se permite curricanear pelágicos (dorado, peto, sierra, picudos).

properties.name: St. Lucie Hump MPA
properties.source: 50 CFR 622.183(a) · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/section-622.183

note.en: No fishing for or keeping snapper-grouper species (bottom fishing); trolling for pelagics (dolphin, wahoo, kings, billfish) is allowed.
note.es: Prohibido pescar o retener pargos, meros y demás especies de fondo del complejo snapper-grouper; se permite curricanear pelágicos (dorado, peto, sierra, picudos).

properties.name: East Hump MPA
properties.source: 50 CFR 622.183(a) · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/section-622.183

note.en: No fishing for or keeping snapper-grouper species (bottom fishing); trolling for pelagics (dolphin, wahoo, kings, billfish) is allowed.
note.es: Prohibido pescar o retener pargos, meros y demás especies de fondo del complejo snapper-grouper; se permite curricanear pelágicos (dorado, peto, sierra, picudos).

properties.name: Warsaw Hole / 50 Fathom Hole Spawning SMZ
properties.source: 50 CFR 622.183(a) · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/section-622.183

note.en: No fishing for or keeping snapper-grouper species (bottom fishing); trolling for pelagics (dolphin, wahoo, kings, billfish) is allowed. No anchoring. Effective until Aug 2, 2027.
note.es: Prohibido pescar o retener pargos, meros y demás especies de fondo del complejo snapper-grouper; se permite curricanear pelágicos (dorado, peto, sierra, picudos). Prohibido anclar. Vigente hasta el 2 de agosto de 2027.

properties.name: Oculina Bank HAPC
properties.source: 50 CFR 622.224(b) · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/section-622.224 (eastern edge between points 21-22 follows the 100-fathom contour; drawn here as a straight line)

note.en: Hook-and-line fishing allowed; fishing vessels may not anchor or use grapples; bottom longline, trawl, dredge, pots and traps prohibited.
note.es: Pesca con anzuelo permitida; las embarcaciones de pesca no pueden anclar ni usar rezón; prohibidos palangre de fondo, arrastre, draga, nasas y trampas.

properties.name: Oculina Experimental Closed Area
properties.source: 50 CFR 622.224(b) · https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/section-622.224

note.en: No fishing for or keeping snapper-grouper species (bottom fishing); trolling for pelagics (dolphin, wahoo, kings, billfish) is allowed. Snapper-grouper caught by accident must be released by cutting the line, without taking the fish out of the water. No anchoring.
note.es: Prohibido pescar o retener pargos, meros y demás especies de fondo del complejo snapper-grouper; se permite curricanear pelágicos (dorado, peto, sierra, picudos). Los que se capturen por accidente se liberan cortando la línea sin sacar el pez del agua. Prohibido anclar.

properties.name: Biscayne bonefish seasonal closed area
properties.source: FWC Biscayne National Park rules (effective Mar 1, 2026) · https://myfwc.com/fishing/saltwater/recreational/bnp/

note.en: All fishing and possession of fish prohibited March 1 – May 31 (bonefish pre-spawning aggregation); transit with gear stowed.
note.es: Prohibida toda pesca y la posesión de peces del 1 de marzo al 31 de mayo (agregación de macabí antes del desove); se puede cruzar con el equipo guardado.
